method: Built-in image_gen for one isolated portrait and four original background assets; editable SVG/Pango lettering and native compositing for twelve banner layouts.

portrait.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: high-resolution transparent manga portrait for an existing channel avatar. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the exact close portrait crop and character identity to preserve; input image 2 is the original full-body drawing, only supporting identity/style reference. Re-render ONLY the person visible in the square avatar crop, not a full-body character. Draw at 2048 by 2048 if possible with genuinely fresh sharp black manga ink and fine readable cross-hatching, no blurry enlarging or artificial sharpening. Preserve the same adult man's exact face proportions, eye shapes and stern calm direct gaze, straight closed mouth, silver-white tousled fringe, nose and jaw, white neutral skin, bare neck/collarbones/shoulders, same head angle and same pose. Composition must closely match image 1: hair crown near 4% of the square height, eyes around 51%, chin around 78%; broad shoulders along the bottom and a tiny visible portion of the raised fist at the lower left. Keep the hair silhouette and head scale; do not zoom out. No torso below the upper chest, no abs, no shorts, no legs. Regenerate the character with crisp elegant deliberate ink linework and controlled crosshatching, not softer or more painterly than the reference. The emerald V is a separate existing native graphic: omit it completely from this portrait asset so it can be composited unchanged later. Output ONLY the isolated monochrome portrait with a genuine alpha-transparent background. No colored hair/eyes/skin, no text, no watermark, no border, no glow, no background scene, no checkerboard drawn into the image.

backgrounds.prompt: Asset type: clean atmospheric background artwork for a minimal wide YouTube channel banner called Rendo. Landscape 2560 by 1440 if possible. The channel palette is near-black, off-white and a restrained deep emerald #0B8371. This is BACKGROUND ART only: no text or lettering, no logo, absolutely no letter V or V-shaped symbol, no people, no fitness equipment, no watermark. Keep the middle horizontal band especially uncluttered and low contrast so crisp typography can be added in code; visual detail mostly toward the lateral edges. Premium understated visual mood, no neon, no purple or cyan, no film grain, no gritty overlay, no distressed paper, no busy scrapbook. Use case: photorealistic-natural. An exceptionally quiet dark evergreen forest at dawn, tall vertical spruce trunks receding into soft slate mist, muted forest-green undertones, dark charcoal negative space. A few distant dim naturally lit trees, not fantasy. Very wide cinematic composition, understated photographic atmosphere and subtle layered depth. No sunbeam spotlight, no camping or hiking icons.
